description: This script is used for flashing bootloader images on a device identified as 'crespo'. It includes functions for flashing the bootloader, but skipping unsupported operations for userdata and radio images.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image on the device, verifying device type and selecting the appropriate bootloader file.

methods.name: flash_userdata_image
methods.description: Intended to flash userdata partition but currently not supported.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Intended to flash radio partition but currently not supported.
